description:
Review finding from worktree-qzr2-wal-trim.

Problem:
The documented distributed durability command currently fails both tests. The test still passes the removed ShardServer version_gap option and calls Demux.push without a known-committed version. Under the new Demux cut protocol, the default five-second cut is never crossed by versions 1000 to 1400 and a nil KCV prevents any pending cut from firing.

Failing command:
BEDROCK_INCLUDE_DISTRIBUTED=1 mix test --include distributed test/bedrock/distributed/minio_durability_test.exs

Observed result:
2 tests, 2 failures, both condition timeouts.

Acceptance criteria:
- Distributed tests configure cut_interval_us on Demux and supply realistic monotonic KCV values.
- Tests still exercise multi-shard minimum durability, restart replay from MinIO, and transient write retry.
- Assertions prove no cut advances before KCV reaches it.
- The documented command passes reliably from a clean checkout with MinIO available.
- Remove obsolete version_gap configuration and add guard coverage so future protocol changes cannot silently turn the suite into timeout-only failures.
title: Repair the distributed MinIO durability gate for cut and KCV semantics
